# MacFarlane Property Group

> MacFarlane Property Group is a tech-driven residential and commercial property management company serving landlords in Cape Town, Mbombela and Johannesburg. Competitive management fees, tailored to your property. The service brings together tenant sourcing and assessment, lease and move-in coordination, maintenance coordination, documented inspections and clear reporting to reduce landlords' everyday administration.

Contact: dean@macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za · +27711720480

## Core pages

- [Services](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/services) — Property management: tenant assessment and communication, maintenance coordination, lease administration, documented inspections and financial reporting.
- [Quote](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/quote) — Competitive management fees, tailored to your property; request a free, no-obligation quote.
- [Switch](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/switch) — Coordinated handovers and clear communication to help landlords switch with confidence.
- [About](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/about) — Founded by Dean MacFarlane on generations of family property experience.
- [Contact](https://www.macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za/contact) — Get a free rental assessment by phone, WhatsApp, or email.
